notes:
POC focused on RAG: large-scale indexed research portal for retail & institutional coverage. Primary workload = embeddings + model-side reranking (vector -> rerank by instruct model). Target index scale = 30-75M documents (research memos, filings, transcripts). Latency SLOs: p50 <80ms, p95 <200ms for cold queries; cost target ~<$0.002 per query (embeddings+rerank combined) — customer explicit ask.

Key technical asks / constraints:
- Dedicated capacity preferred (predictable throughput during earnings windows).
- VPC/private control plane + US-only residency; "can't tolerate cross-border data transfer" (quote from Head of Engineering).
- KMS/HSM integration mandatory; customer will supply key material (bring-your-own-key). Must support CMK rotation and audit hooks.
- Audit logging retention 7 years; integration with SIEM (Splunk).
- Hybrid retrieval: vector store + BM25 fallback for exact-match legal citations. Reranking model must accept contextual signals and be pinned per route.
- Deterministic tokenization and canonicalization for embeddings to keep drift low across model upgrades.

POC results so far: indexing throughput fine; embeddings generation pipeline scales but cost drift on high-cardinality prompts. Reranker quality good on top-10 but increases per-query latency; investigating continuous batching and KV cache warmup to hit p95.
